entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The petitioners are seeking quashing of the FIR bearing Banka P.S. Case No. 499 of 2022 registered for the Patna High Court CR. MISC. No.22660 of 2023(2) dt.17-10-2023 offence punishable under Section 498A, 379/34 of the IPC and Section  of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2. Petitioners are near relatives of the informant's daughter.
The informant's daughter was married to one Rahul Kumar.
The allegation is of demand of dowry and theft of articles.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners has submitted that a false case has been registered against all the family members of the husband of the informant's daughter because of matrimonial dispute between them.
It has been submitted that upon completion of investigation the police has submitted chargesheet against all the petitioners.
4. At this stage, I am not inclined to entertain the application for quashing of the FIR as chargesheet has already been submitted.
5. This application is accordingly dismissed with liberty to the petitioners to take the plea of their false implication at appropriate stage before the court below.

(Chakradhari Sharan Singh, J) Nishant/-
